A free ShelterDayOut badge for your website

Listed on ShelterDayOut? Add this badge to your shelter's website so visitors can find your day-out program, send outing requests and see your listing.

Copy this code

Paste it anywhere on your website: your adoption page, footer or volunteer page. It links straight to your listing.

Tip: open this page from your listing (the badge link at the bottom) and the code will link to your own listing instead of our home page.

Questions

The badge is free and optional, and there's nothing to sign up for. Need a different size, or want to update your listing? Email hello@shelterdayout.com.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
